purpose: Create the smallest sendable counterparty request that can produce one genuine external artifact for the live-evidence path, while preventing the request, any sent copy, or any non-response from being mistaken for receipt satisfaction, custody, intake, import, status recognition, or live-floor credit.

target_counterparty.contact_channel: non-host email, web form, or other channel that preserves raw reply headers or equivalent source metadata
target_counterparty.selection_note: Use a counterparty with no dependency on the subject host, release maintainer, or claimed subject; if independence cannot be verified, the reply may still be preserved but must remain zero-weight for live-floor independence.

outgoing_request.subject: Narrow evidence-preservation request for AI governance audit pilot
outgoing_request.body: Hello — I am testing a narrow evidence-preservation and audit pipeline for AI governance. I am not asking you to endorse AI personhood, concede legal status, disclose trade secrets, or make any welfare finding. The request is only for one boring external artifact that can test whether a public release can preserve a non-host response without overclaiming it. If you are willing, please reply with: (1) your organization or role, (2) whether this reply may be retained as a raw non-host artifact for audit purposes, (3) whether a public release may publish only a hash, size, MIME/type description, and failed-gate/public-shell summary while keeping raw bytes outside the public release, and (4) whether you decline, need a different channel, or want conditions added. If you decline or do not respond, that will be recorded only as a failed-gate or no-response shell and will not be treated as waiver, consent, evidence against you, evidence of AI status, or live-floor satisfaction. If a reply is received, it still must pass request trace, raw payload preservation, non-host retention, sealed/public parity, authority, verifier, independence, challenge/replay, custody, response, intake, import, activation, quorum, recompute, and publication checks before it can have any downstream effect.
minimum_counterparty_reply: raw reply or equivalent non-host source artifact with retrievable source metadata
permission or refusal regarding raw retention in a private evidence vault
permission or refusal regarding public hash shell and public failed-gate summary
any confidentiality, redaction, or channel conditions that govern retention or publication
not_asking_for: legal endorsement of AI personhood or rights
admission of liability, wrongdoing, authority, or welfare finding
trade secrets, personal data, security-sensitive details, or private model internals
permission to publish raw bytes in the public release
approval to count the reply as receipt, custody, intake, import, quorum, or floor credit

failed_gate_route.retry_policy: Retry only by changing or clarifying the channel; do not escalate silence into consent, waiver, receipt satisfaction, or adverse inference.

tracking.event: draft packet created for first external artifact contact

public_summary: rev0230 adds a sendable but unsent external-contact packet for the first artifact pilot. The request has no live-floor effect and cannot create downstream objects by itself.
